parameters.content:
## 💼 Job Feed → Slack

Gathers remote jobs + freelance gigs from **Remotive, RemoteOK, Arbeitnow, Freelancer.com, OnlineJobs.ph** (free) + **JSearch** (Indeed/LinkedIn/Glassdoor/ZipRecruiter via RapidAPI), keeps only the ones matching your skills (UI/UX, React/Next web dev, AI automation, graphic design), de-duplicates across runs, and posts a digest to your Slack channel.

Runs daily at 8:00 AM. Click Execute to test now.

## ⚙️ SETUP

**Slack:** posts to channel ID set in Config → channelIdOverride (already set to C0BD3AX4ZLN). Make sure the bot is invited to that channel (`/invite @your-bot`).

**RapidAPI key:** stored in credential “RapidAPI - JSearch”. ⚠️ Your current plan only enables `/job-details`, NOT `/search` — so JSearch is skipped until you subscribe to a JSearch plan that includes the **Search** endpoint. The 3 free boards work regardless.

**Run:** click Execute to test, or it runs daily at 8 AM.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: channelName = Slack channel to create/post. channelIdOverride = paste an existing channel ID to skip auto-create.

nodes.name: Resolve Channel ID
nodes.notes: Uses channelIdOverride from Config. (Auto-create-by-name path kept in code for portability if override is cleared.)

nodes.name: Fetch Free Boards
nodes.notes: Remotive + RemoteOK + Arbeitnow + Freelancer.com (freelance gigs). Each in try/catch so one failing never breaks the run.

nodes.name: Fetch OnlineJobs.ph
nodes.notes: Scrapes OLJ public job search (4 keyword pages) and parses listings. Best-effort: may break if OLJ changes their HTML. onError=continue so a block/redesign never breaks the run.

nodes.name: JSearch Queries
nodes.notes: One search query per item. Edit this list to tune what JSearch looks for.

nodes.name: JSearch Search
nodes.notes: Aggregates Indeed/LinkedIn/Glassdoor/ZipRecruiter. Secret key via the RapidAPI credential; host header is non-secret.

nodes.name: Normalize JSearch
nodes.notes: Flattens JSearch results into the common job shape.

nodes.name: Filter & Score by Skills
nodes.notes: Dedups, scores each job against your skills, drops non-matches, and remembers what was already posted (no repeats).
